crossRefs.note: The men sampled their provisions, and didn’t ask counsel from Yahweh’s mouth.
He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor being hasty with one’s feet and missing the way.
The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.
Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?
So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
Afterward, David’s heart struck him, because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.
He said to his men, “Yahweh forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, Yahweh’s anointed, to stretch out my hand…
Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I…
So David went, he and the six hundred men who were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those who were left…
But David pursued, he and four hundred men; for two hundred stayed behind, who were so faint that they couldn’t go over…
David came to the two hundred men, who were so faint that they could not follow David, whom also they had made to stay…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: David said to his men, “Every man put on his sword!” Every man put on his sword. David also put on his sword. About four hundred men followed David, and two hundred stayed by the baggage.
translations.bsb: And David said to his men, “Strap on your swords!” So David and all his men strapped on their swords, and about four hundred men followed David, while two hundred stayed with the supplies.
translations.kjv: And David said unto his men, Gird ye on every man his sword. And they girded on every man his sword; and David also girded on his sword: and there went up after David about four hundred men; and two hundred abode by the stuff.
translations.asv: And David said unto his men, Gird ye on every man his sword. And they girded on every man his sword; and David also girded on his sword: and there went up after David about four hundred men; and two hundred abode by the baggage.
